name: rhino-chatgpt-bridge

modeling_authority.note: ChatGPT Web is the normal Rhino modeling author. Local AI executes, validates, captures, saves, and reports. Local modeling is only authorized when the active structured request explicitly grants it.

principles: Git is the durable source of truth.
Operator work happens on a task branch, not directly on main.
Operator reports are committed after the work commit and reference that work commit.
The controller reviews operator evidence before merge.
